GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 10 January 2026
The depression over the southwest Bay of Bengal was located about 20 km East of Mullaittivu at
11:30 a.m. on 10 January 2026. It is likely to cross the Mullaittivu coast around today evening. It
is likely to weaken to a low-pressure area by tomorrow. Accordingly, it can be expected that the
influence of this system on the island's weather will gradually reduce by tomorrow.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Northern, North-central, Uva, and Eastern
provinces.
Several spells of showers may occur in the North-western and Central provinces.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a several places elsewhere during evening or night.
Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Northern, North-western
provinces and in Matale, Trincomalee and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
